ValidationRule.description: Description cannt be empty for comment and compliment type of cases.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", TEXT($User.UserType) <> "AutomatedProcess", ISBLANK( Description ), OR ( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Latam_Compliment', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Latam_Comment' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Description field cannot be empty. Please provide case description.
